overview_description: List alerts for the instance or for one account, employee or labour, and retrieve one alert.
intro: Alerts flag records that need attention. You can list every alert, list the alerts of one account, employee or labour, and retrieve a single alert. This area has 5 endpoints, and all seven SDKs call every one.
notes: **Alerts are read only.** You can list them for the instance or for one account, employee or labour, and read one by id.
**Employees and labours are identified by their `code`.** An account is named by its `id`, such as `W13ZGY`.
**Every list has the same shape.** Alerts sit under `data` beside `object`, `url` and `pagination`, and an empty `data` means no alerts.
**Listings page by cursor.** Records sit under `data`; pass `pagination.next_cursor` as `cursor` to read the next page, and stop when `pagination.has_more` is `false`.

endpoints.title: List alerts
endpoints.summary: Lists the alerts on your instance, one page at a time.
endpoints.description: Returns a page of alerts under `data`, with cursor `pagination`. Other fields filter as `filter_<field>` for equality or `filter_<field>_<operator>`, such as `filter_created_on_gte`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `pagination.next_cursor` of the previous page, to read the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: A field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve an alert
endpoints.summary: Retrieves one alert by its id.
endpoints.description: Name the alert by the `id` a listed alert carries.

parameters.name: alert_id
parameters.description: The alert's `id`, as the listing shows it.

endpoints.title: List an account's alerts
endpoints.summary: Lists the alerts raised for one account.
endpoints.description: Returns the account's alerts under `data`, with cursor `pagination`. An account with no alerts returns an empty `data`.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: The account's `id`, such as `W13ZGY`. Not its `uuid`.

endpoints.title: List an employee's alerts
endpoints.summary: Lists the alerts raised for one employee.
endpoints.description: Name the employee by its `code`. Returns the employee's alerts under `data`, with cursor `pagination`; an employee with no alerts returns an empty `data`.

endpoints.title: List a labour's alerts
endpoints.summary: Lists the alerts raised for one labour.
endpoints.description: Name the labour by its `code`. Returns the labour's alerts under `data`, with cursor `pagination`; a labour with no alerts returns an empty `data`.

url.description: The path this page was read from.

limit.description: The page size applied to this page.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows. Trust this over `next_cursor`, which can still be set on the last page.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to read the next page.
